export_magnified: This view is shown as a magnified picture, and is exported as shown.
export_shape: Another shape than the picture on the screen: the picture is drawn again, which takes longer.
export_larger: At this size the picture is drawn again for the file, which takes longer.
export_too_large: the picture is too large for this quality
export_no_room: This device does not have the memory for a picture of this size.
already_running_file: Fractique is already running: the file opens in its window.
export_file: the file could not be written
open_failed: The file could not be opened
versions_failed: The versions could not be loaded
this_version: This is the version you have.
ready: Fractique {v} is downloaded. It installs when you close the app.
dev_build: A development build: it does not install releases.
manual_copy: This copy cannot replace itself: get a version from its download page.
allow_storage: Allow storage access to save the picture.
gpu_note: With acceleration on, the picture and the exports can look slightly different from device to device.
exact_note: Exports are drawn by the processor: the same pixels on every device, and slower.
export_card: Drawn on the graphics card: quick, and slightly different from device to device.
export_processor: Drawn on the processor: the same pixels on every device.
gpu_weak: On a weak graphics chip this can be slower than without it.
pro_about: Save as many pictures a day as you like, export at any custom size, and hide the panels to see the picture alone. You pay once and it is yours for good. Everything else stays free.
saves_none: No free saves left today. Fractique Pro saves without a limit.
pro_owned: Fractique Pro is yours. Thank you!
pro_failed: The purchase did not go through.
pro_no_product: The App Store did not answer. Try again in a moment.
pro_nothing: No earlier purchase was found for this Apple Account.
pro_not_allowed: Purchases are switched off on this device.
pro_deferred: The purchase is waiting for approval.
